primary_contact_roles: VP Infrastructure (exec sponsor), Director of Clinical Informatics (use-case owner), Security/GRC lead (controls), Storage/Backup team (ops), Network team (air-gap constraints)
workload_summary: Private deployment targeted for PHI-adjacent text workflows (summaries + routing). Majority traffic internal users; bursty during clinic hours. They want predictable latency for interactive UI (p95 < 1.5s for short responses) and ability to pin model versions for validation cycles.
private_dr_requirements_summary: Strict DR posture. Must support: (1) on-prem Kubernetes, (2) fully air-gapped mode (no outbound internet), (3) customer-owned encryption keys (HSM preferred), (4) evidence artifacts for audits, (5) repeatable restore drills with measured RTO/RPO.
rpo_rto_targets: Requested targets (initial): RPO 15 minutes for control plane DB; RTO 2 hours for full service restore. They may accept 'Standard' tier (RPO 1 hour / RTO 4 hours) for pilot if automation + evidence is solid.
data_and_state_to_protect_notes: They asked for explicit inventory of 'what gets backed up' incl: control plane DB(s), policy/config, certs, audit log export config, model/artifact cache, and any object storage used for logs/trace exports. Also want clarity on what is *not* covered (e.g., upstream IdP, external SIEM).
air_gapped_constraints: No direct S3/GCS/Azure endpoints. Preferred storage target: on-prem object store (MinIO) or NFS-backed repository in a restricted VLAN. Backup bundle must be transferable via offline media for certain environments. They flagged max file size limits in their staging repo and want chunking/compression guidance.
encryption_and_key_handling_notes: Strong stance: Redwood must never handle plaintext customer keys. Prefer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys; OK with KMS-like integration if it can point to their HSM-backed service. Logging must redact secrets and not include signed URLs. Rotation expectations: annual (or on demand after incident).
audit_evidence_expectations: Need 'restore drill packet' per quarter: timestamps, operator identity, commands executed, checksums, proof of encryption settings, success/failure logs, and RTO/RPO achieved. Asked if we can standardize a template and what metrics/dashboards we provide.
procurement_status: Legal + Security review in progress. Procurement asked for (a) DR tooling description, (b) key ownership statement, (c) support coverage during restore drills, (d) packaging details for air-gapped updates and signatures.
